title: Moon Phases
caption: One Sun, one light: phases and eclipses, traced
blurb: An orrery of the Sun, the Earth and the Moon (not to scale) with the Sun as its only light. The Moon’s lit half, the phase seen from the ground, the Moon’s shadow crossing the Earth and the Earth’s shadow putting the Moon out are not scripted: they fall out of where the three bodies are.

controls.does: jumps to the next phase: new, half, full, half
plays a solar eclipse, then a lunar one

controls.input: V, or click the Earth or the Moon
controls.does: stands on the Earth and looks up, and back

credits.what: Earth colour map (Blue Marble Next Generation, December 2004, with topography and bathymetry; scaled down, sea brightened) and the roughness map derived from it
Moon colour map (CGI Moon Kit, LROC colour mosaic, 2k)
